facts.text: I am trying to organize my shopping expenses for the month.
I sometimes buy multiple items of the same product, like two pairs of jeans.
I find it hard to keep track of the total cost when the price is not listed separately for each item.
I bought a few camisoles from H&M.
I bought a pair of ankle boots from Zara.
I bought a set of notecards from The Paperie.
I bought a custom planner from Etsy.
I bought an eyeshadow palette from Sephora.
I bought a few travel-sized skincare products from Drunk Elephant.
I bought two pairs of jeans from Levi's at Macy's.
I checked my receipts to find prices for some items.
I spent $60 on the ankle boots from Zara.
I spent $40 on the eyeshadow palette from Sephora.
I spent $20 on the notecards from The Paperie.
I spent $80 on the custom planner from Etsy.
I want help calculating the total cost of the jeans from Levi's at Macy's.
I bought two pairs of jeans and want to make sure the total cost is correct.
I got 30% off the jeans.
I do not recall the original price of the jeans.
I want to calculate the price per pair if I provide the total amount spent after the discount.

events.text: Checked receipts to find prices for some items.
Found prices for ankle boots, eyeshadow palette, notecards, and custom planner on receipts.
